The petitioner is the accused in Crime No.1032 of 2023 of Cherupuzha Police Station, Kannur,
alleging commission of offence under Section 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code.

3. The allegation against the petitioner is that, by giving a false promise of marriage, the petitioner indulged in sexual relationships with the defacto complainant/victim at several places and on several occasions and thereby, he committed the offence alleged against him.

4. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner and the defacto complainant/victim were known to each other from the time they were studying together for the Pre-Degree course.

It is submitted that a friendship developed between the petitioner and the defacto complainant/victim and even going by the statements in the First Information Statement of the defacto complainant/victim, they were in a relationship from September 2002 and they had travelled to various places and had stayed together and had sexual relationships on multiple occasions.

It is submitted that, even according to the First Information Statement, the defacto complainant/victim came to know that the petitioner was in a subsisting marriage and was having a cordial relationship with his wife and have three children, while they had stayed together in Telengana in the month of September 2022.
It is submitted that, even thereafter, the defacto complainant continued the relationship with the petitioner.

It is submitted that the First Information Statement also shows that though the defacto complainant/victim has been living separately from her husband for a long time, the marriage between the defacto complainant and her husband has not been legally dissolved.

It is submitted that, in such circumstances, it could not be said that the petitioner had committed rape on the false promise of marriage and any relationship between the petitioner and the defacto complainant/victim cannot be termed as consensual.
5. The learned Public Prosecutor opposes the grant of bail.
It is submitted that there are serious allegations against the petitioner.

It is submitted that, according to the defacto complainant/victim,
she was made to believe that the petitioner was also living separately from his wife and he was intending to get legal separation from his wife.

It is submitted that, in such circumstances, it cannot be said that the petitioner had obtained consent of the defacto complainant/victim for sexual relationships, it could be said that on the basis of a false promise.
It is submitted that the matter is under investigation.
Grant of bail to the petitioner at this stage may not be conducive.

6. Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor and considering the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the opinion that the petitioner can be granted bail subject to conditions, as held in Johnson v. State of Kerala; [2023 (6)
KLT 29].

entities.text:
Johnson v. State of Kerala; [2023 (6)
KLT 29]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: If the co-operation of the petitioner can be ensured, no compelling reason to hold that custodial interrogation of the petitioner is necessary in the facts and circumstances of this case.

Pertinently, I must note that, even according to the defacto complainant/victim, though she was living separately from her husband for some time, her marriage with her husband has not been legally dissolved.
Therefore, prima facie, I find merit in the contention taken by the learned counsel for the petitioner that there could not have been a false promise of marriage.
In the result, this application is allowed.

If any of the aforesaid conditions are violated, the Investigating officer in Crime No.1032 of 2023 of Cherupuzha Police Station, Kannur shall file an application before the jurisdictional Court for cancellation of bail.
Any observation in this order shall not be treated as a finding by this Court on any point and those observations are only for the purposes of considering the entitlement of the petitioner for bail.
